title: Trusted Source Review Cleanup: metadata-only and false-friend rows stop shipping

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.95 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.95 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow source-trust filtering release; targeted regressions plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on a fresh deployed v0.15.94 ZIP/log audit. A fresh deployed v0.15.95 ZIP/log audit is still required before claiming provider package quality improvement.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: The release is grounded in a fresh deployed v0.15.94 UX ZIP/log audit that regraded 97/A and exposed remaining metadata-only and false-friend source debt.
Source-finder candidates must have URL/DOI proof, a non-ambiguous license, and domain-appropriate source text before attachment.
Metadata-only source-finder fallbacks are dropped instead of exported as sourceReviewRows.
UX source filtering and grading reject prototype-programming and mechatronics/manufacturing false friends.
The release explicitly carries forward partial-enrichment and clean-provider-audit requirements instead of claiming 100/100.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh v0.15.95 UX ZIP/log audit and verify metadata-only source-finder rows, generated-syllabus mechatronics rows, and prototype-programming false friends no longer ship.
Investigate lesson 1 template fallback after repair/retry if it reproduces in the fresh v0.15.95 audit.
